VMTP.Transfer.Title: Transfer Inventory
VMTP.Transfer.Hint: Move every physical item and all coins from the first selected token to the second
VMTP.Transfer.NeedTwo: Select two tokens: source first, destination second.
VMTP.Transfer.Same: Both tokens share one actor. Nothing to move.
VMTP.Transfer.Ask: Move every physical item and all coins from {src} to {dst}? Features stay put. This cannot be undone.
VMTP.Transfer.Done: Moved {items} item(s) and {coins} coin(s) from {src} to {dst}.
